description: Silver data-quality contract for NYC TLC Yellow Taxi trips.

rejection_rules.name: pickup_zone_unknown
rejection_rules.description: Pickup location is null or absent from the taxi-zone reference domain.

rejection_rules.name: dropoff_zone_unknown
rejection_rules.description: Dropoff location is null or absent from the taxi-zone reference domain.

rejection_rules.name: duration_nonpositive
rejection_rules.description: Trip duration is missing, zero, or negative.

rejection_rules.name: pickup_outside_month
rejection_rules.description: Pickup timestamp falls outside the declared source month.

rejection_rules.name: passenger_over_6
rejection_rules.description: Passenger count is greater than six.

quality_flag_rules.name: total_amount_zero
quality_flag_rules.description: Total trip amount is exactly zero.

quality_flag_rules.name: passenger_nonpositive
quality_flag_rules.description: Passenger count is present but zero or negative.
